scripts.install:python: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip && .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run venv && npm run install:python
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "AI,BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "yellow,green,cyan" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.db:migrate: psql -U postgres -d medorbit -f db/00_extensions.sql && psql -U postgres -d medorbit -f db/01_base_tables.sql && psql -U postgres -d medorbit -f db/02_dependent_tables.sql && psql -U postgres -d medorbit -f db/03_indexes.sql && psql -U postgres -d medorbit -f db/04_triggers_sequences.sql && psql -U postgres -d medorbit -f db/05_views.sql && psql -U postgres -d medorbit -f db/06_seed_data.sql
